title: Report On Lecture Titled The Status Of Shanghai

Subject (in full) Report on Lecture titled the "Status of Shanghai" delivered
by Dr. C.L. Hsia at the Foreign Y.M.C.A. on the evening of
November 26, 1929.
Made by D.S. O'Neill. Forwarded by J. Givens A.C.

This lecture if such it might be called was given before
a mixed audience of foreigners and Chinese, who were given
an opportunity to question the speaker at the conclusion of
the lecture on the various points raised.

Dr. Hsia in opening his address dwelt some time on the
origin of the Settlement, quoting freely from the early treaties
and pointed out that in analysing these treaties there were
no legal grounds for the foundation of the Settlement. The
speaker then traced the rise of the original Settlement which
was controlled by a Committee of Roads and Jetties for approximate-
ly 10 years till in 1854 the Shanghai Municipal Council as it
is known today was inaugurated with the consent of the Ministers
at Peking, but without the sanction of the Chinese Government
which Dr. Hsia states shows that the Settlement as it now
functions is independent of both the Chinese and Foreign
Governments and here asks whether it is a sovereign state.
To more clearly point this out he made reference to the May
30th incident, when the Diplomatic body at Peking sent a
commission to inquire into that affair and which subsequently
as a result of these inquiries ordered that the then commissioner
of Police and Inspt. Everson be dispensed with. The Municipal
Council, Dr. Hsia points out in defying these orders clearly
showed its independence of the Diplomatic Body and how much
more is this the case in dealing with the Chinese Authorities
who have no redress for any action of the Municipal Council
detrimental to the Chinese.

From the above reasoning the lecturer then spoke of the
unfair discrimination between foreigners and Chinese in the
Settlement and went over the well trodden paths of everyday

主题（全称）关于夏奇林（C.L. Hsia，音译）博士于1929年11月26日晚在青年会外侨部所作题为“上海之地位”演讲的报告。
由 D.S. 奥尼尔（O'Neill）撰写。经 J. 吉文斯（Givens）助理督察转发。

这场演讲——如果可以这样称呼的话——是面向由外侨和华人组成的混合听众进行的，在演讲结束时，听众有机会就提出的各个要点向演讲者提问。

夏博士在开场白中花了相当长的时间讲述租界的起源，大量引用早期条约，并指出在分析这些条约时，租界的建立并无法律依据。随后，演讲者追溯了最初租界的兴起过程，该租界由道路码头委员会控制约10年，直到1854年，在今日所知的上海工部局成立之时，虽得到了驻北京公使团的同意，但未获中国政府批准。夏博士称，这表明目前运作的租界独立于中国和外国政府之外，并在此询问其是否为一个主权国家。为了更清楚地说明这一点，他提到了五卅惨案，当时驻北京的外交团派遣了一个委员会调查该事件，随后根据调查结果命令撤换当时的警务处长和埃弗森（Everson）巡官。夏博士指出，工部局违抗这些命令，清楚地表明了其独立于外交团，而在对待中国当局时更是如此，因为对于工部局做出的任何损害华人利益的行为，中国当局均无补救办法。

基于上述推理，演讲者接着谈到了租界内外侨与华人之间不公平的歧视问题，并老调重弹地提及日常

Chinese propaganda against the foreigner making mention of the
privileges such as parks: hospitals: libraries: etc., which
the foreigner enjoys but which the Chinese are barred from.
It is here that Dr. Hsia either deliberately or otherwise made
a number of false statements with reference to these same
privileges possibly thinking that as some of his arguments
are sound and "were accepted by liberal minded men at the Kyoto
Conference" that these latter statements would be accepted
as conclusive, which is often the case. Especially would those
not acquainted with local conditions readily acquiesce to
Dr. Hsia's astute propaganda for the early rendition of the
Settlement following the abolition of extraterritoriality.
It is significant to note that he made no reference to
the Provisional Court or its functions and it is only to be
assumed that he refrained from doing so as he feared that
certain questions would be brought up by the attendance which
might well tax the ingenuity of the lecturer to answer
satisfactorily.

A. M. Shield

针对外侨的宣传，提到了公园、医院、图书馆等外侨享有而华人被禁止进入的特权。正是在这里，夏博士无论是故意还是其他原因，就这些特权做出了一些虚假陈述，他可能认为，既然他的一些论点站得住脚且“被京都会议上的开明人士所接受”，那么这些后来的陈述也会被当作确凿结论而被接受，这种情况经常发生。特别是那些不熟悉当地情况的人，很容易默许夏博士那种鼓吹在废除治外法权后尽早归还租界的巧妙宣传。值得注意的是，他没有提及临时法院或其职能，只能推测他是因担心听众提出某些问题，而这些问题可能会让演讲者难以巧妙且令人满意地作答，故而避而不谈。
